method: Original authored notes arranged using recorded guitar, bass and drum samples, rendered offline with amp and spatial processing. Not a live band performance.

external_samples.name: Karoryfer Shinyguitar electric pickup
external_samples.author: Karoryfer Samples / D. Smolken
external_samples.recording: Real recorded electric guitar magnetic pickup
external_samples.mapping_note: root_midi follows original SFZ pitch_keycenter (default 60 where omitted).
external_samples.tuning_note: tuning_cents is measured recorded pitch offset above root_midi (positive means sharp), estimated from weighted first four harmonics 0.2-1.4 seconds after onset. To play target MIDI use rate=2**((target-root_midi-tuning_cents/100)/12). Source WAV bytes preserved unmodified.
external_samples.onset_note: onset_frame marks first sample over max(0.002, peak*0.01), retaining 1.5 ms pre-attack; optional start point for tight note placement.

external_samples.name: Karoryfer Growlybass
external_samples.author: Karoryfer Samples / D. Smolken
external_samples.recording: Real recorded Squier Jazz Bass direct, both pickups
external_samples.mapping_note: root_midi describes actual sounding pitch; original SFZ bass roots are one octave higher than the recorded fundamentals.
external_samples.tuning_note: tuning_cents is measured recorded pitch offset above root_midi (positive means sharp), estimated from weighted first four harmonics 0.2-1.4 seconds after onset. To play target MIDI use rate=2**((target-root_midi-tuning_cents/100)/12). Source WAV bytes preserved unmodified.
external_samples.onset_note: onset_frame marks first sample over max(0.002, peak*0.01), retaining 1.5 ms pre-attack; optional start point for tight note placement.

external_samples.author: Karoryfer Samples / Karoryfer Lecolds
external_samples.mix_notes: Original close microphone + stereo overhead, plus quiet bottom snare microphone. Common onset trim and 15ms tail fade. Constant gain per articulation; no synthesized drums, no pitch changes, no normalization per hit.
external_samples.velocity_notes: velocity is the rounded upper bound of the original evenly spaced source layer (127 * layer / layer_count). Choose nearest desired velocity, then rotate round_robin. Recorded level differences are preserved; do not normalize each hit.

reference: Broad melodic action-rock stage atmosphere of Mega Man X4/X5/X6; no soundtrack copying.
audio_format: 44.1 kHz stereo; PCM16 WAV masters and Vorbis OGG runtime assets.
qa_scope: Automated decoded-audio measurements and separate Unity playback smoke. No claim of human auditory review.
